children: Trader Bonk Guy, also known as Unipcs, said he lost millions of dollars through overtrading after suffering an eight-figure loss. According to PANews, he said the loss occurred on October 10, 2025, amid systemwide failures at major centralized exchanges and was the largest single-day loss of his career.

In the weeks and months that followed, he continued trading in an effort to recover the losses and prove himself. Bonk Guy said he would have been a better trader if he had forced himself to stop for several months or longer. He added that skill and experience alone do not ensure consistent outperformance, and that market conditions, timing and luck also play a role. He said that sometimes the best move is to stay out of the market and wait for another opportunity.

title: Bonk Guy Says Overtrading After Eight-Figure Loss Cost Him Millions
